subject: world_language
concept: Understanding and producing nuanced argumentation with qualifications, exceptions, and conditional reasoning
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'nuanced argumentation' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a nuanced qualifying phrase ('although,' 'except in cases where') to the argument it modifies
exercise.abstract: Student writes an argument that includes at least one genuine qualification or exception, in the target language

misconception_flags: presents an argument as absolute with no acknowledgment of any genuine exception or qualification

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
